g.text: Product-led vs sales-led: who moves the user forward?
the buyer discovers and pays differently, so the GTM differs
product-led: the product sells itself (Calendly, Slack)
no sales call needed; the user is the buyer or the champion
sales-led: marketing makes leads, salespeople convert them
slower and costlier per customer, good for high-value deals
choose by how the buyer discovers and pays for the product
